text: In 2022, ___ demonstrated free-space MEMS optical circuit switching at production data-center scale, reaching 91.7% demand satisfaction while using about one-tenth the switching power of the best electronic alternative.
explanation: Google's 2022 deployment of free-space MEMS OCS in the spine layer was the first large-scale production validation of optical circuit switching, matching electronic demand satisfaction (91.7% vs 91.4%) at about one-tenth the switching power.
